jump-chain.goal: Capture every enemy piece before the ranks reach your side.
jump-chain.how-to-play.step-1: Drag your piece one square diagonally, or tap where it should go.
jump-chain.how-to-play.step-2: Jump over an enemy next to you to capture it.
jump-chain.how-to-play.step-3: Land next to the next enemy and keep jumping: one chain can capture a whole rank.
jump-chain.how-to-play.step-4: Every few moves the enemy ranks advance. Don’t let them reach your side!
jump-chain.lose.overrun: The enemy ranks reached your side
jump-chain.name: Jump Chain
jump-chain.tagline: Jump, then jump again. Clear the ranks.
jump-chain.tutorial.step-1: Drag your piece one square up, next to the enemy.
jump-chain.tutorial.step-2: Now jump! Drag over the enemies to capture them in a chain.
jump-chain.tutorial.step-3: The ranks advanced. Jump again before they reach your side.
